summary: CCC-built 1933 Aermotor tower above Malheur NWR headquarters; abandoned as a fire lookout, closed by 2012, and used mostly for wildlife viewing.

facts.status_note: Standing but abandoned as a fire lookout. A May 2012 visit found it closed with the bottom stairs removed; the 2026 directory lists it as abandoned.

access.note: Tower closed as of the May 2012 visit, bottom stairs removed. The site is on refuge headquarters grounds, and the directory lists it as legally accessible to the public.

visit.trail_note: Sits on a bluff above the refuge headquarters.

events.note: Constructed by the Civilian Conservation Corps at the Malheur refuge headquarters.
CCC camp preparing foundation piers for a 99-foot steel observation tower; newspaper gives the planned height.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register July 16, 2002.
May 15, 2012 visit: tower closed, bottom set of stairs removed.
January 2, 2016: a group occupied the refuge headquarters; the lookout on the hill above was being used as an observation point.

corrections.why: 30.2 m is 99 feet, the planned height in a 1935 newspaper. The firelookout page and the 2012 visit give the built tower as 90 feet; the register gives 80 feet.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register: 80 ft (24.4 m). Firelookout and the 2012 visit: 90 ft. The 1935 newspaper gives 99 ft as planned. The record uses 90 ft, the height the 2012 visit recorded on site; the story reports all three.
The register says the tower is still maintained for emergency use. The 2012 visit found it closed, and the 2026 directory lists it as abandoned. The record uses the newer evidence.
Register: 4,190 ft (1,277 m). The 2012 blog and 2026 directory give 4,200 ft. The record keeps the register figure, which matches the brief.

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 30.2 is the planned 99-foot height from 1935, not the built height; corrected to 90 ft. The register's 80 ft is kept in the story. Status is standing but abandoned, with the last direct observation in May 2012; the 2026 directory is the only current source. Access is closed as of 2012 and not re-checked. The 2016 occupation is included only as a neutral event; the source is a compiled history page.
